column4: Email recipient and entity relations do not establish caller access or verified ownership.
Provider-network categories lack verified tenant mapping and security requirements.
Provider network provider is resource metadata, not verified caller tenancy.
Assay reference search has no affirmative unrestricted-access statement.
Enforcement-case report describes public-looking records but supplies no affirmative API-access policy.
Collection-record retrieval has wskey input and unknown security without explicit unrestricted access.
Summary explicitly states character public information and supplied character attributes contain no conflicting private-access rule.
Character bookmarks require OAuth permission but creator_id is unverified and not necessarily the character-owner lookup.
Utility document comparison includes billing account data without a verified caller ownership relation.
Entity ownershipResolved concerns corporate identity data, not the API caller's authority to update it.
Named-entity recognition requires a user key without a concrete supported caller authorization rule.
Account-organizer listing has no verified caller-account relationship or specified security.
Organizer-session report lacks an owner lookup and has unknown security.
Group access requests require a token but no explicit caller role or group authorization relation is given.

Volunteer retrieval has unknown security and no affirmative unrestricted-access or ownership evidence.

Concept metadata has unknown security and no affirmative unrestricted-access statement.
public_content OAuth permission does not itself prove unrestricted location API access.
Comment removal has authentication and comments permission but only result wrappers, not ownership binding.
Assigning loyalty points exposes user_id but does not prove self-service ownership or a required caller role.

External-user lookup has authorizationPossible and homeOrg attributes without verified caller access semantics.

Project information has owner and organization hints but no verified caller-to-project authorization relation.
Adding a project participant has only error fields and no verified org or caller-role rule.
Branch company name is address metadata, not verified caller tenancy, and security is unknown.
Client SNP retrieval has bearer security but genotype fields do not establish caller-dataset ownership.

Administrative division means geography, not an admin role; API authorization beyond UserSecurity is unspecified.

Funding reversal specifies transaction conditions and refund destination, not verified caller ownership or role authorization.
Market-class reference metadata has unknown security and no affirmative unrestricted-access evidence.
Album lookup requires a key but only result wrappers, with no explicit unrestricted-access statement.
Server owner is inferred and role_id is an optional authentication scheme, not a concrete caller role.
Account userid is inferred and optional role_id scheme does not prove a role or ownership authorization rule.
User-account listing has server context but wrapper-only ERD cannot establish verified ownership.
Account holdings supplies only a holdings wrapper and unknown security, leaving caller-account authorization unresolved.
